name: Orion
description: General-purpose web browser with tabs, history and bookmarks.

name: Netflix
description: Netflix, opened in your browser. netflix.com doesn’t allow being shown inside other sites, so Orion hands it to a normal browser tab.

name: YouTube
description: YouTube as a dedicated app. youtube.com forbids embedding, so the app falls back to YouTube’s official embed player and Data API.

name: GeForce NOW
description: Cloud gaming portal with gamepad, fullscreen and keyboard access, plus connection diagnostics.
allow: autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad; keyboard-map; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; microphone; camera

name: Roblox
description: Roblox through the configured cloud-streaming page (172.ip.nowgg.fun), opened in your browser. Orion doesn’t host, stream or route it.

name: CineJoy
description: The CineJoy website (cinejoy.pk), opened in your browser. It’s a third-party site: Orion doesn’t host, stream or check its content.

name: Spiceify
description: Music player for audio files and streaming-service embeds. Library defined in content/music.json.

name: Vapor
description: Game store and library. Launches HTML5 and web-hosted games in their own windows. Catalogue in content/games.json.

name: App Store
description: Install, remove and launch apps, or turn any website into an app.

name: Notepad
description: Text and Markdown editor with server-side storage, upload and download.

name: Settings
description: Personalization, wallpaper, taskbar position, accounts and system information.

name: Orion OS API Playground
description: Internal developer tool for the window.ltf app API.

name: Vapor Player
description: Window host for games launched from Vapor.
